title: Q6
description:
Read: Psa 8:4-6, Psa 110:1

"A little lower" can be read "for a little while lower." One text still does not see all things under man. The other seats a Lord until the footstool is made.

a) Which text supplies the "not yet," and which supplies the man who is crowned?

b) If the lowering is a short time, what does the death do inside that time, rather than as a permanent rank under angels?
